overclaims: AlphaGeometry2 keeps that design, with a Gemini-based language model and an improved symbolic engine, and solves 84% of IMO geometry problems.
AlphaProof is a learned agent that finds proofs in the Lean formal language, and it reached silver-medal level at IMO 2024.
AG2 keeps the same neural language model plus symbolic engine design and reaches an 84% solve rate on IMO geometry.
checks.note: The 84% result is scoped to IMO geometry problems from 2000–2024, not IMO geometry generally. The silver-medal-equivalent score belongs to AlphaProof combined with AlphaGeometry2, using multi-day computation; AlphaProof alone solved three of five non-geometry problems. Restore these qualifications. The excerpt, proposition, citation metadata and agreed outcome match.
